# Shared journal-entry table columns

All Journal Entries and each typed journal tab use this schema with a fixed journal-type filter where applicable.

| # | Column ID | Label | Type | Default | Sortable | Filterable | Display behavior |
|---:|---|---|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|---|
| 1 | `entry_no` | Entry No. | reference | Yes | Yes | No | Human-friendly reference; opens the authoritative detail. |
| 2 | `journal_type` | Journal Type | enum | Yes | Yes | Yes | Localized text; null values render as an em dash. |
| 3 | `entry_date` | Entry Date | date | Yes | Yes | Yes | Localized display; API remains ISO-8601; date filter enabled. |
| 4 | `posting_date` | Posting Date | date | Yes | Yes | Yes | Localized display; API remains ISO-8601; date filter enabled. |
| 5 | `fiscal_period` | Fiscal Period | text | Yes | Yes | No | Localized text; null values render as an em dash. |
| 6 | `source_module` | Source Module | text | Yes | Yes | No | Localized text; null values render as an em dash. |
| 7 | `source_document_type` | Source Document Type | enum | Yes | Yes | Yes | Localized text; null values render as an em dash. |
| 8 | `source_reference` | Source Reference | reference | Yes | Yes | Yes | Human-friendly reference; opens the authoritative detail. |
| 9 | `description` | Description | text | Yes | No | No | Wrap or truncate with tooltip; full value in detail dialog. |
| 10 | `total_debit` | Total Debit | money | Yes | Yes | No | Right-aligned; currency precision; subtotal when meaningful. |
| 11 | `total_credit` | Total Credit | money | Optional | Yes | No | Right-aligned; currency precision; subtotal when meaningful. |
| 12 | `difference` | Difference | money | Optional | Yes | No | Right-aligned; currency precision; subtotal when meaningful. |
| 13 | `currency` | Currency | currency | Optional | Yes | Yes | Localized text; null values render as an em dash. |
| 14 | `department` | Department | text | Optional | Yes | Yes | Localized text; null values render as an em dash. |
| 15 | `cost_centre` | Cost Centre | reference | Optional | Yes | No | Human-friendly reference; opens the authoritative detail. |
| 16 | `entry_status` | Entry Status | status | Yes | Yes | Yes | Localized `AppWorkspaceStatusBadge`; never expose raw enum text. |
| 17 | `approval_status` | Approval Status | status | Yes | Yes | Yes | Localized `AppWorkspaceStatusBadge`; never expose raw enum text. |
| 18 | `created_by` | Created By | text | Optional | Yes | No | Localized text; null values render as an em dash. |
| 19 | `approved_by` | Approved By | text | Optional | Yes | No | Localized text; null values render as an em dash. |
| 20 | `posted_by` | Posted By | text | Optional | Yes | No | Localized text; null values render as an em dash. |

Every entry detail includes a balanced nested journal-line table. Debit must equal credit before approval or posting.
